applicability.reason: The browser control plane and local inference server expose complete user/system and external-application journeys whose assembled HTTP, UI, runtime-state and cleanup behavior cannot be proven by lower-level tests alone.

target_environments.description: A supported Apple Silicon Mac running the packaged Local LLM Server with a representative production model/backend and the browser control plane.
material_dimensions: model family artifact identity and quantization
runtime backend implementation and accelerator support
Apple Silicon architecture and macOS lifecycle behavior
production-sized context input and output shape
sustained latency throughput thermal and power behavior when performance is claimed

execution_environments.artifact_surface: source checkout running the real FastAPI/middleware/UI stack with deterministic in-process inference, exercised through Chromium and a direct external loopback HTTP API client
known_gaps: does not load a production model
does not execute production MLX or llama.cpp backend processes on Apple Silicon
does not reproduce target unified-memory pressure thermals or accelerator behavior
does not prove production-model latency throughput or output quality

execution_environments.artifact_surface: freshly built and installed wheel exercised through the repository built-surface journey and package smoke contracts
known_gaps: Linux host is not representative of macOS runtime and accelerator behavior
production model/backend and unified-memory behavior remain outside this environment
hardware performance and thermal claims remain unproven

execution_environments.artifact_surface: real Local LLM Server runtime with representative model/backend configuration using the device-evidence runbook
known_gaps: representative hardware may differ from the exact target Mac memory tier or OS revision
evidence supports only the recorded model/backend configuration and workload shape

execution_environments.artifact_surface: release-equivalent Local LLM Server build with the intended production model/backend configuration

critical_journeys.claim: A user can open the control plane, understand truthful server/runtime status and navigate core surfaces through the assembled browser and HTTP boundary.
residual_gaps: target macOS process and backend state can still expose platform-specific lifecycle differences

critical_journeys.claim: A user can configure a text request, submit it, observe truthful progress or failure, receive a result through the public boundary and recover for the next request.
residual_gaps: real model loading token generation cancellation and backend error behavior require representative hardware evidence
latency throughput memory and thermal claims require the recorded target model backend and workload

critical_journeys.claim: An external local application can discover runtime identity and capabilities, use text vision transcription evaluation and policy/admin HTTP contracts, select explicit or default routes, receive fail-closed errors and privacy-safe streams, exercise different resident runtimes concurrently and recover after a backend-originated failure without calling product internals.
residual_gaps: the deterministic engine does not prove production llama.cpp or MLX adapter process behavior, model loading or native cancellation semantics
real backend compatibility memory reclamation latency throughput quality and accelerator behavior require representative Apple Silicon evidence

critical_journeys.claim: Model availability residency pinning unload and resource-state actions remain coherent across the public control plane and runtime owner without unsafe eviction or leaked ownership.
residual_gaps: actual MLX or llama.cpp allocation reclamation and unified-memory pressure cannot be proven by the deterministic fixture
automatic pressure behavior remains gated by representative-device evidence

critical_journeys.claim: A user can run or review evaluation state and comparable history with durable execution identity without confusing unavailable measurements with zero.
residual_gaps: representative-model repeatability and hardware-sensitive metrics require real-device runs with retained model configuration and build identity

critical_journeys.claim: A complete automated product run releases its owned server process listener browser session temporary evaluation state and bounded diagnostic evidence on success and failure paths.
residual_gaps: real backend sessions and accelerator resources require representative-device shutdown and reclamation confirmation
